answer: Because the lotus stake is held until the sparrow settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the canyon audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 35% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. A farm running 152 keys thus pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
